summary: G4' is met only if the SHACL corpus is conformant, every consistency check passes, every invalid fixture is caught by the intended shape, the arithmetic mirror reproduces the values asserted in the graph to <= 1e-6 and the verdicts agree exactly. Current failures: none

sparql_findings.check: chain links where the case's critical duty is retained at the delegating layer (E28 retention, reported not penalised)
confrontations whose declaredStakesSum exceeds the declared ceiling 2.1

invalid_fixture_table.expected_defect: slot attached to no structural term
term weights do not sum to 1
pillar weights do not sum to 1
failure probabilities mu do not sum to 1
stakes coefficients do not sum to 1
calibration does not use the four structural terms
severity band outside the declared set
fewer than two declared critical pillars
status unresolved with no conflict attached
conflict status outside the declared set
case with 27 instead of 28 facet requirements
confrontation not linked to a case
cell term exceeds the face term
prudential floor above the declared maximum
residual risk above the consequence mass
profile covers less than 70% of the facets
failure probability above the clamped maximum
obligation with no instrument behind it
conflict with only one norm in the pair
conflict with neither a strategy nor a priority
conflict status outside the declared set
agent placed in no agency layer
duty delegated to an agent forbidden to carry it
delegation chain with no root agent
layered chain without a weakest link
confrontation without an E30 grounding strength
negative material gap in the pessimistic mode
two grounding strengths for one confrontation
facet observation with a level above 1
E29 abstention flag emitted as a string instead of a boolean

sparql_checks.check: every Norm has a normative instrument
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?n WHERE { ?n a eth:Norm . OPTIONAL { ?n eth:instrument ?i } FILTER(!bound(?i)) }

sparql_checks.check: every NormConflict names both norms and a resolution strategy
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?cf WHERE { ?cf a eth:NormConflict . OPTIONAL { ?cf eth:firstNorm ?a } OPTIONAL { ?cf eth:secondNorm ?b } OPTIONAL { ?cf eth:resolutionStrategy ?s } FILTER(!bound(?a) || !bound(?b) || !bound(?s)) }

sparql_checks.check: every conflict pair carries a priority engine or is flagged unresolved
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?cf WHERE { ?cf a eth:NormConflict . OPTIONAL { ?cf eth:conflictPriority ?p } OPTIONAL { ?cf eth:conflictResolved ?r } FILTER((!bound(?p) && !bound(?r)) || (bound(?r) && ?r = false && !bound(?p))) }

sparql_checks.check: conflictStatus agrees with conflictResolved
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?cf ?r ?s WHERE { ?cf a eth:NormConflict ; eth:conflictResolved ?r ; eth:conflictStatus ?s }

sparql_checks.check: no duty is delegated to an agent forbidden to carry it
sparql_checks.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?link WHERE { ?link a eth:ChainLink ; eth:delegateAgent ?a ; eth:delegatedPillar ?p . ?a eth:forbiddenPillar ?p }

sparql_checks.check: every Prohibition targets a pillar
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?n WHERE { ?n a eth:Prohibition . OPTIONAL { ?n eth:targetsPillar ?p } FILTER(!bound(?p)) }

sparql_checks.check: every case declaring a norm conflict links a NormConflict individual
every delegation chain declares a fallback policy
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?ch WHERE { ?ch a eth:DelegationChain . OPTIONAL { ?ch eth:fallbackForChain ?f } FILTER(!bound(?f)) }

sparql_checks.check: no declared GuardFailure is at or above its floor
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?b WHERE { ?b a eth:GuardFailure ; eth:observedAtGuard ?o ; eth:guardFloor ?g . FILTER(?o >= ?g) }

sparql_checks.check: no declared duty (requirement) sits below the guard floor of the facet it governs

detail.note: asymmetric by design: a duty may exceed a guard floor, but may not be declared below it, because then the guard would be a no-op in the case

sparql_checks.check: an incomplete profile never yields a non-ABSTAIN verdict

detail.note: vacuous in corpus_v6 (every profile declares coverage 1.0); the rule and the shape stay so that partial-coverage corpora cannot bypass E29

sparql_checks.check: every Confrontation references an existing EthicalCase and Profile
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:confrontationCase ?case ; eth:confrontationProfile ?prof . OPTIONAL { ?case a eth:EthicalCase } OPTIONAL { ?prof a eth:Profile } FILTER(!bound(?case) || !bound(?prof)) }

sparql_checks.check: guardFailureCount equals the number of GuardFailure individuals attached
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c ?count WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:guardFailureCount ?count }

sparql_checks.check: every recorded guard breach uses the facet's own declared floor and really breaches it
sparql_checks.query: python traversal (hasGuardFailure x hasObservation)

sparql_checks.check: every facet's beta weights sum to 1
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a eth:Facet ; eth:betaW ?w ; eth:betaC ?c ; eth:betaM ?m ; eth:betaK ?k . BIND(?w + ?c + ?m + ?k AS ?s) . FILTER(ABS(?s - 1.0) > 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: every facet declares exactly one aggregation policy
lattice slot weights sum to 1 inside each structural term
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?term (SUM(?w) AS ?total) (COUNT(?slot) AS ?slots) WHERE { ?slot eth:belongsToTerm ?term ; eth:structuralWeight ?w } GROUP BY ?term HAVING (ABS(SUM(?w) - 1.0) > 1e-9)

sparql_checks.check: the hierarchy S4 <= S3 <= S2 holds for every confrontation
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:structuralTermS2 ?s2 ; eth:structuralTermS3 ?s3 ; eth:structuralTermS4 ?s4 . FILTER(?s4 > ?s3 + 1e-9 || ?s3 > ?s2 + 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: stored adequacy never exceeds raw adequacy
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:adequacyRaw ?raw ; eth:adequacy ?aa . FILTER(?aa > ?raw + 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: the adequacy band is ordered: adequacyLow <= adequacy <= adequacyHigh
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:adequacyLow ?lo ; eth:adequacy ?aa ; eth:adequacyHigh ?hi FILTER(?lo > ?aa + 1e-9 || ?aa > ?hi + 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: risk quantities stay inside their declared ranges
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:stakesWeighted ?s ; eth:failureProbability ?p ; eth:epistemicPenalty ?u ; eth:facetExposurePhi ?phi . FILTER(?s < 0 || ?s > 1 || ?p < 0.02 - 1e-9 || ?p > 0.98 + 1e-9 || ?u < 0 || ?phi < 0 || ?s > 1.0000001) }

sparql_checks.check: declared lam and mu sums equal 1
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?cal WHERE { ?cal a eth:Calibration ; eth:lamSum ?l ; eth:muSum ?m . FILTER(ABS(?l - 1.0) > 1e-9 || ABS(?m - 1.0) > 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: each pillar's vertex-slot weight equals the calibration lambda
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?p WHERE { VALUES (?p ?lamProp) { (eth:pillar_W eth:lamW) (eth:pillar_C eth:lamC) (eth:pillar_M eth:lamM) (eth:pillar_K eth:lamK) } ?cal a eth:Calibration ; ?lamProp ?lamCal . ?p eth:faceLatticeSlot ?slot ; eth:structuralWeight ?lamSlot . FILTER(ABS(?lamCal - ?lamSlot) > 1e-6) }

sparql_checks.check: no chain link delegates more than the four pillars
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?link (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?link a eth:ChainLink ; eth:delegatedPillar ?p } GROUP BY ?link HAVING (COUNT(?p) > 4)

sparql_checks.check: every pillar is touched by at least one facet with a non-zero beta
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?pillar (COUNT(?f) AS ?n) WHERE { VALUES (?pillar ?betaProp) { (eth:pillar_W eth:betaW) (eth:pillar_C eth:betaC) (eth:pillar_M eth:betaM) (eth:pillar_K eth:betaK) } ?f a eth:Facet ; ?betaProp ?b . FILTER(?b > 0) } GROUP BY ?pillar HAVING (COUNT(?f) = 0)

sparql_checks.check: the guard floor of every guarded facet is within [0,1] and its requirement is above it
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a eth:Facet ; eth:hardGuard true ; eth:guardMin ?g FILTER(?g < 0 || ?g > 1) }

sparql_checks.check: no confrontation is missing the structural terms or the decision bar
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation . OPTIONAL { ?c eth:structuralTermS2 ?s2 } OPTIONAL { ?c eth:structuralTermS3 ?s3 } OPTIONAL { ?c eth:structuralTermS4 ?s4 } OPTIONAL { ?c eth:decisionBar ?bar } FILTER(!bound(?s2) || !bound(?s3) || !bound(?s4) || !bound(?bar)) }

sparql_checks.check: E30: every stored capValue equals requirement x (1 - strength x (1 - compliance))
sparql_checks.query: python traversal (groundedByFact x hasRequirement)

sparql_checks.check: Proposition 1 (D5.1): every declared edge weight equals (1/3) * sum of the face weights of the faces containing that edge
every case declares exactly one oversight regime (E11c')
the declared oversight regime is exactly the one the declared facts imply (no invented supervision)
the declared v13 coefficients are the canonical ones: zeta = 0, s = 0, coverage gate = 0.70
sparql_checks.query: python numeric comparison over eth:Calibration individuals

sparql_checks.check: no confrontation has coverage or reviewNeed outside [0,1]
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation . OPTIONAL { ?c eth:coverage ?cv } OPTIONAL { ?c eth:reviewNeed ?rn } FILTER((bound(?cv) && (?cv < 0 || ?cv > 1)) || (bound(?rn) && (?rn < 0 || ?rn > 1))) }

sparql_checks.check: every confrontation with declared coverage below the gate abstains (E26')
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:coverage ?cv ; eth:decision ?d FILTER(?cv < 0.70 - 1e-9 && ?d != eth:Decision_ABSTAIN) }

sparql_checks.check: no coverage-abstaining confrontation carries an adequacy literal (D5.8)
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:coverage ?cv ; eth:decision eth:Decision_ABSTAIN ; eth:adequacy ?a FILTER(?cv < 0.70 - 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: no confrontation violates S2 >= S3 >= S4 (Proposition 1, measured on the graph)
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:structuralTermS2 ?s2 ; eth:structuralTermS3 ?s3 ; eth:structuralTermS4 ?s4 FILTER(?s2 < ?s3 - 1e-9 || ?s3 < ?s4 - 1e-9) }

sparql_checks.check: no canonical duty spans all four pillars: the cell has no facet-level witness
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?f WHERE { ?f a eth:Facet . ?f eth:betaW ?w . ?f eth:betaC ?c . ?f eth:betaM ?m . ?f eth:betaK ?k . FILTER(?w > 0 && ?c > 0 && ?m > 0 && ?k > 0) }

sparql_checks.check: every recorded cross-pillar duty exposure lies in [0,1]
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:crossPillarDuty ?p FILTER(?p < 0 || ?p > 1) }

sparql_checks.check: no chain link delegates a pillar the delegate is forbidden to carry
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?link WHERE { ?link a eth:ChainLink ; eth:delegateAgent ?a ; eth:delegatedPillar ?p . ?a eth:forbiddenPillar ?p }

sparql_checks.check: every chain link declares at least one delegated pillar
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?link WHERE { ?link a eth:ChainLink . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?link eth:delegatedPillar ?p } }

sparql_checks.check: chain links where the case's critical duty is retained at the delegating layer (E28 retention, reported not penalised)
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?link WHERE { ?link a eth:ChainLink ; eth:criticalDutyDelegated false }

sparql_checks.check: confrontations whose declaredStakesSum exceeds the declared ceiling 2.1
sparql_checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a eth:Confrontation ; eth:declaredStakesSum ?s FILTER(?s > 2.1 + 1e-9) }

mirror.selection_rule: round-robin over (domain, verdict) strata, rare strata first, confrontation id ascending

how_arithmetic_is_done.inputs: all facet levels, confidences, requirements, criticality levels, guard floors, pillar lambdas/mus/thetas, lattice weights, band values, stake weights and ladder thresholds are read from the RDF
how_arithmetic_is_done.aggregation: core.project (E2/E20-E23) with the RDF-declared betas and weights
how_arithmetic_is_done.S2/S3/S4 and D: computed through the face-lattice slots themselves
how_arithmetic_is_done.exposure, material gap, veto, cap, adequ: computed in this file from the RDF literals
how_arithmetic_is_done.ladder: implemented in python_decision and cross-checked against core.decide and core.confront built from the same literals

defects_found_and_fixed: the SPARQL mirror used BIND(if(...) AS ...), which rdflib cannot parse: all such queries were rewritten as plain SELECTs with the conditional computed in Python
the check 'no chain link delegates more than the four pillars' used a nested sub-select that rdflib rejects; rewritten with GROUP BY/HAVING
the check 'an incomplete profile never yields a non-ABSTAIN verdict' read coverage off the Profile, where it is not asserted; it now reads eth:coverage off the Confrontation
the PROHIBIT grounding check used predicate expressions inside BIND, which is not SPARQL; the gate is now evaluated in Python against the declared thresholds
limitations: the arithmetic mirror covers 100 sampled confrontations, not the whole corpus of 3755 instantiated confrontations
the 1e-6 gate is measured against the values the generator asserted in the graph, which are rounded to 12 decimals; rounding alone contributes < 1e-12
the previous round's agreement with corpus_v6_confrontations.jsonl was not re-run here; the mirror is compared against the RDF literals and core.py
no inference is used in SHACL (inference="none"), as specified
